description: If total computable \(f\) satisfies \(x\in K\Longleftrightarrow f(x)\in C\), and \(a\) indexes its joint preimage procedure, the exact total computable map \(e\mapsto f(g_a(e))\) is productive for \(\overline C\). No enumerability assumption on \(C\) is needed for this escape conclusion.
